title: Probability that both special bits vanish
statement: Consider the hard distribution's sample space, whose points carry two special-coordinate bits $x_T, y_T \in \{0,1\}$ (among other data), equipped with the uniform probability measure. The event that both special bits vanish, $x_T = 0$ and $y_T = 0$, has probability $\tfrac{1}{4}$.
hypotheses_covered: the event that the two special bits x_T and y_T are both false (zero)
the measure is the uniform (volume) probability measure on the finite sample space
